description: 61 additional dated first-pass devotional drafts, with distinct short prayers and reflections. All entries require human originality, doctrinal, stylistic and KJV review before publication.

entries.title: Obedience Beyond Hearing
entries.reflection: James warns that listening to Scripture without acting on it can deceive us. Choose a specific command of Christ to practise today, allowing God's Word to shape both motive and conduct.
entries.prayer: Father, give me grace to practise what Your Word teaches and to repent when I fall short.

topics.bibleText: Wilt thou not revive us again: that thy people may rejoice in thee?
topics.reflection: The psalmist's prayer for revival seeks renewed joy in God. Begin by turning from a neglected duty and returning to sincere devotion.
topics.prayer: Lord, revive my desire for Your presence and strengthen renewed obedience.

topics.bibleText: Because it is written, Be ye holy; for I am holy.
topics.reflection: Peter calls believers to holiness because God is holy. Reject a convenient compromise rather than postponing what you know is right.
topics.prayer: Holy Father, shape my private decisions by Your character.

topics.bibleText: To the chief Musician for the sons of Korah, A Song upon Alamoth. God [is] our refuge and strength, a very present help in trouble.
topics.reflection: The psalm calls God our present help in trouble. Trust Him while carrying out the practical responsibilities before you.
topics.prayer: God of refuge, grant me courage and wisdom for today's challenges.

topics.bibleText: Pray without ceasing.
topics.reflection: Paul's instruction to pray continually invites dependence in every task. Name a specific person and intercede for their needs.
topics.prayer: Father, teach me to remember others faithfully in prayer.

topics.bibleText: ¶ Repent ye therefore, and be converted, that your sins may be blotted out, when the times of refreshing shall come from the presence of the Lord;
topics.reflection: Peter urges repentance and a return to God. Let the gospel confront excuses and lead you to a genuine change of direction.
topics.prayer: Lord Jesus, forgive my wrongdoing and help me turn from it.

topics.bibleText: But without faith [it is] impossible to please [him]: for he that cometh to God must believe that he is, and [that] he is a rewarder of them that diligently seek him.
topics.reflection: Hebrews teaches that seeking God requires faith. Obey what is clear even while waiting for answers to what remains uncertain.
topics.prayer: Father, make my trust steady and my obedience sincere.

topics.bibleText: But ye shall receive power, after that the Holy Ghost is come upon you: and ye shall be witnesses unto me both in Jerusalem, and in all Judæa, and in Samaria, and unto the uttermost part of the earth.
topics.reflection: Jesus promised the Holy Spirit's power for witness. Depend on Him to speak truthfully rather than using bold words to impress.
topics.prayer: Holy Spirit, give me courage and purity of motive in witness.

topics.bibleText: And he said unto them, Go ye into all the world, and preach the gospel to every creature.
topics.reflection: Christ sends His disciples to proclaim the gospel. Explain His saving work with clarity and kindness, not pressure.
topics.prayer: Lord Jesus, help me share Your good news respectfully.

topics.bibleText: By this shall all [men] know that ye are my disciples, if ye have love one to another.
topics.reflection: Jesus says love identifies His disciples. Show love through a helpful deed toward someone who cannot repay you.
topics.prayer: Father, teach me to love through humble service.

topics.bibleText: But be ye doers of the word, and not hearers only, deceiving your own selves.
topics.reflection: James says hearing the Word is not enough. Translate one instruction from Scripture into a definite act of obedience.
topics.prayer: Lord, keep me from empty agreement and guide my actions.

topics.bibleText: If any of you lack wisdom, let him ask of God, that giveth to all [men] liberally, and upbraideth not; and it shall be given him.
topics.reflection: James invites those lacking wisdom to ask God. Pause before reacting and consider what Scripture teaches about the decision.
topics.prayer: Father, give me discernment and a teachable heart.

topics.bibleText: Therefore be ye also ready: for in such an hour as ye think not the Son of man cometh.
topics.reflection: Jesus calls us to readiness because the hour is unknown. Daily faithfulness matters more than speculation about dates.
topics.prayer: Lord Jesus, keep me watchful through obedient living.

entries.title: Holiness in Everyday Speech
entries.reflection: God's holiness is not only a public confession. Let His Word govern the way you speak, especially when offended or hurried, and seek reconciliation where your words have caused harm.
entries.prayer: Holy Father, purify my words and give me humility to correct what I have said wrongly.

topics.bibleText: Wilt thou not revive us again: that thy people may rejoice in thee?
topics.reflection: Revival renews our love for God and for His ways. A changed tone in conversation may reveal more than outward excitement.
topics.prayer: Father, renew my heart so that my words reflect Your grace.

topics.bibleText: Because it is written, Be ye holy; for I am holy.
topics.reflection: God commands holiness because He is holy. Refuse slander and dishonest speech even when others encourage it.
topics.prayer: Lord, keep my speech truthful and my motives clean.

topics.bibleText: To the chief Musician for the sons of Korah, A Song upon Alamoth. God [is] our refuge and strength, a very present help in trouble.
topics.reflection: God is refuge in trouble. When criticised, seek His help before letting fear or anger govern your answer.
topics.prayer: Father, help me respond to hardship with patience and hope.

topics.bibleText: Pray without ceasing.
topics.reflection: To pray without ceasing is to keep turning toward God. Ask His help before entering a difficult conversation.
topics.prayer: Lord, teach me to speak carefully and to pray before I answer.

topics.bibleText: ¶ Repent ye therefore, and be converted, that your sins may be blotted out, when the times of refreshing shall come from the presence of the Lord;
topics.reflection: Repentance includes acknowledging harmful words. When appropriate, apologise clearly instead of minimising the hurt caused.
topics.prayer: Jesus, make me quick to confess wrongdoing and seek peace.

topics.bibleText: But without faith [it is] impossible to please [him]: for he that cometh to God must believe that he is, and [that] he is a rewarder of them that diligently seek him.
topics.reflection: Faith trusts God's character without needing to win every argument. Speak truth kindly even when it is misunderstood.
topics.prayer: Father, strengthen my faith to remain truthful and gentle.

topics.bibleText: But ye shall receive power, after that the Holy Ghost is come upon you: and ye shall be witnesses unto me both in Jerusalem, and in all Judæa, and in Samaria, and unto the uttermost part of the earth.
topics.reflection: The Spirit empowers witness to Christ. Spiritual boldness must not become permission to humiliate or threaten others.
topics.prayer: Holy Spirit, make my witness courageous and compassionate.

topics.bibleText: And he said unto them, Go ye into all the world, and preach the gospel to every creature.
topics.reflection: Christ commands the gospel to be preached. Share the truth of salvation without insults or manipulation.
topics.prayer: Lord, give me wise and respectful words when sharing the gospel.

topics.bibleText: By this shall all [men] know that ye are my disciples, if ye have love one to another.
topics.reflection: Jesus says disciples are recognised by love. Listen fully before replying to a fellow believer with whom you disagree.
topics.prayer: Father, form patient and sincere love in my conversations.

topics.bibleText: But be ye doers of the word, and not hearers only, deceiving your own selves.
topics.reflection: James urges believers to act on Scripture. Put away an unkind expression and replace it with a truthful, gracious reply.
topics.prayer: Lord, let Your Word govern what I say today.

topics.bibleText: If any of you lack wisdom, let him ask of God, that giveth to all [men] liberally, and upbraideth not; and it shall be given him.
topics.reflection: James says wisdom is a gift to seek from God. Test an accusation before repeating it and welcome correction.
topics.prayer: Father, give me restraint, humility and sound judgment.

topics.bibleText: Therefore be ye also ready: for in such an hour as ye think not the Son of man cometh.
topics.reflection: Jesus calls His followers to readiness. Watchfulness also includes responsible words in the ordinary moments of life.
topics.prayer: Lord Jesus, keep my speech and conduct faithful until You return.

entries.title: A Faith That Serves Others
entries.reflection: Faith that seeks God should also bear fruit in everyday relationships. Following Christ includes noticing another person's burden and responding with appropriate, practical kindness.
entries.prayer: Father, help me express faith through humble service and sincere concern for my neighbour.

topics.bibleText: Wilt thou not revive us again: that thy people may rejoice in thee?
topics.reflection: Revival is more than a personal feeling; renewed love for God should awaken care for people around us.
topics.prayer: Lord, revive my compassion and guide me toward useful service.

topics.bibleText: Because it is written, Be ye holy; for I am holy.
topics.reflection: God's holiness calls for fairness in how we treat others. Do not neglect someone simply because they lack status.
topics.prayer: Holy Father, remove favouritism and pride from my conduct.

topics.bibleText: To the chief Musician for the sons of Korah, A Song upon Alamoth. God [is] our refuge and strength, a very present help in trouble.
topics.reflection: Psalm 46 speaks of God as refuge. Offer steady encouragement to someone struggling, without promising immediate relief.
topics.prayer: Lord, give me truthful words of hope for those in trouble.

topics.bibleText: Pray without ceasing.
topics.reflection: Paul teaches continual prayer. Intercede for people with burdens you cannot solve, while considering what help you can provide.
topics.prayer: Father, teach me to pray and to serve where I am able.

topics.bibleText: ¶ Repent ye therefore, and be converted, that your sins may be blotted out, when the times of refreshing shall come from the presence of the Lord;
topics.reflection: Peter calls people to repent and turn to God. If your indifference has hurt someone, admit it and respond differently.
topics.prayer: Jesus, forgive my selfishness and renew my willingness to care.

topics.bibleText: But without faith [it is] impossible to please [him]: for he that cometh to God must believe that he is, and [that] he is a rewarder of them that diligently seek him.
topics.reflection: Faith seeks God sincerely. Express that trust by following through on a promise made to someone in need.
topics.prayer: Father, make my faith reliable in both words and actions.

topics.bibleText: But ye shall receive power, after that the Holy Ghost is come upon you: and ye shall be witnesses unto me both in Jerusalem, and in all Judæa, and in Samaria, and unto the uttermost part of the earth.
topics.reflection: The Holy Spirit empowers believers to witness. A caring deed may support the gospel message when joined to truthful speech.
topics.prayer: Holy Spirit, strengthen me to serve others without seeking praise.

topics.bibleText: And he said unto them, Go ye into all the world, and preach the gospel to every creature.
topics.reflection: Jesus commands believers to proclaim the gospel. Listen with respect to the person before offering your testimony.
topics.prayer: Lord, give me compassion and wisdom as I speak of Christ.

topics.bibleText: By this shall all [men] know that ye are my disciples, if ye have love one to another.
topics.reflection: Christ says love identifies His disciples. Welcome an overlooked person and consider how to make fellowship more inclusive.
topics.prayer: Father, help me honour others and build genuine Christian unity.

topics.bibleText: But be ye doers of the word, and not hearers only, deceiving your own selves.
topics.reflection: James commands obedience to Scripture. Choose one practical kindness rather than stopping at good intentions.
topics.prayer: Lord, make me willing to act on Your Word through service.

topics.bibleText: If any of you lack wisdom, let him ask of God, that giveth to all [men] liberally, and upbraideth not; and it shall be given him.
topics.reflection: God gives wisdom to those who ask. Consider the other person's actual needs before offering advice or assistance.
topics.prayer: Father, guide me to help wisely and without presumption.

topics.bibleText: Therefore be ye also ready: for in such an hour as ye think not the Son of man cometh.
topics.reflection: Jesus calls believers to be ready for His return. Faithful readiness includes loving service today.
topics.prayer: Lord Jesus, keep me watchful and generous in daily life.

entries.title: Growing in Faith and Obedience
entries.reflection: God calls His people to hear His Word and obey it with sincerity.
entries.prayer: Lord, teach me to walk in Your truth.

topics.bibleText: Wilt thou not revive us again: that thy people may rejoice in thee?
topics.reflection: Revival starts with a heart that seeks God rather than applause. Examine your motives in the light of Scripture on 11/16; let gratitude guide your next action.
topics.prayer: Father, renew my desire to seek You; teach me truthfulness in my family.

topics.bibleText: Because it is written, Be ye holy; for I am holy.
topics.reflection: A holy life grows through ordinary choices made in obedience. Respond with patience instead of haste on 11/16; let this teaching guide your response to difficulty.
topics.prayer: Father, help me choose what is holy; teach me truthfulness in my family.

topics.bibleText: To the chief Musician for the sons of Korah, A Song upon Alamoth. God [is] our refuge and strength, a very present help in trouble.
topics.reflection: God is a refuge even when answers seem delayed. Make time for quiet reflection on this verse on 11/16; respond with patience instead of haste.
topics.prayer: Father, strengthen my confidence in Your care; teach me truthfulness in my family.

topics.bibleText: Pray without ceasing.
topics.reflection: Prayer keeps our dependence on God active through the day. Ask how this Scripture should shape your words on 11/16; act faithfully even without recognition.
topics.prayer: Father, teach me to pray with perseverance; teach me truthfulness in my family.

topics.bibleText: ¶ Repent ye therefore, and be converted, that your sins may be blotted out, when the times of refreshing shall come from the presence of the Lord;
topics.reflection: Christ calls sinners to turn toward Him in repentance and faith. Let this teaching guide your response to difficulty on 11/16; look for an opportunity to practise this truth.
topics.prayer: Father, lead me in repentance and faith; teach me truthfulness in my family.

topics.bibleText: But without faith [it is] impossible to please [him]: for he that cometh to God must believe that he is, and [that] he is a rewarder of them that diligently seek him.
topics.reflection: Trust in God is shown when obedience costs us comfort. Share encouragement rooted in this passage on 11/16; bring a neglected responsibility before God.
topics.prayer: Father, help me trust and obey Your Word; teach me truthfulness in my family.

topics.bibleText: But ye shall receive power, after that the Holy Ghost is come upon you: and ye shall be witnesses unto me both in Jerusalem, and in all Judæa, and in Samaria, and unto the uttermost part of the earth.
topics.reflection: The Spirit strengthens believers for Christlike living and witness. Bring a neglected responsibility before God on 11/16; ask how this Scripture should shape your words.
topics.prayer: Father, fill me with courage through Your Spirit; teach me truthfulness in my family.

topics.bibleText: And he said unto them, Go ye into all the world, and preach the gospel to every creature.
topics.reflection: The gospel is good news to be shared with compassion. Let gratitude guide your next action on 11/16; examine your motives in the light of Scripture.
topics.prayer: Father, make me a faithful and gentle witness; teach me truthfulness in my family.

topics.bibleText: By this shall all [men] know that ye are my disciples, if ye have love one to another.
topics.reflection: Christian unity requires patience and practical love. End the day by reviewing your obedience on 11/16; remember someone who needs your kindness.
topics.prayer: Father, teach me to love fellow believers; teach me truthfulness in my family.

topics.bibleText: But be ye doers of the word, and not hearers only, deceiving your own selves.
topics.reflection: The Word becomes fruitful when we put it into practice. Look for an opportunity to practise this truth on 11/16; end the day by reviewing your obedience.
topics.prayer: Father, make me a doer of Your Word; teach me truthfulness in my family.

topics.bibleText: If any of you lack wisdom, let him ask of God, that giveth to all [men] liberally, and upbraideth not; and it shall be given him.
topics.reflection: God gives wisdom to those who ask in faith. Choose humility when your plans are interrupted on 11/16; share encouragement rooted in this passage.
topics.prayer: Father, give me wisdom for today's choices; teach me truthfulness in my family.

topics.bibleText: Therefore be ye also ready: for in such an hour as ye think not the Son of man cometh.
topics.reflection: Watchfulness means living faithfully while awaiting Christ. Remember someone who needs your kindness on 11/16; make time for quiet reflection on this verse.
topics.prayer: Father, keep me watchful and faithful; teach me truthfulness in my family.

entries.prayer: Lord, teach me to walk in Your truth.

topics.bibleText: Wilt thou not revive us again: that thy people may rejoice in thee?
topics.reflection: Revival starts with a heart that seeks God rather than applause. Act faithfully even without recognition on 12/22; respond with patience instead of haste.
topics.prayer: Father, renew my desire to seek You; teach me compassion in my conversations.

topics.bibleText: Because it is written, Be ye holy; for I am holy.
topics.reflection: A holy life grows through ordinary choices made in obedience. Consider how this truth shapes your private decisions on 12/22; act faithfully even without recognition.
topics.prayer: Father, help me choose what is holy; teach me compassion in my conversations.

topics.bibleText: To the chief Musician for the sons of Korah, A Song upon Alamoth. God [is] our refuge and strength, a very present help in trouble.
topics.reflection: God is a refuge even when answers seem delayed. Examine your motives in the light of Scripture on 12/22; look for an opportunity to practise this truth.
topics.prayer: Father, strengthen my confidence in Your care; teach me compassion in my conversations.

topics.bibleText: Pray without ceasing.
topics.reflection: Prayer keeps our dependence on God active through the day. Respond with patience instead of haste on 12/22; bring a neglected responsibility before God.
topics.prayer: Father, teach me to pray with perseverance; teach me compassion in my conversations.

topics.bibleText: ¶ Repent ye therefore, and be converted, that your sins may be blotted out, when the times of refreshing shall come from the presence of the Lord;
topics.reflection: Christ calls sinners to turn toward Him in repentance and faith. Make time for quiet reflection on this verse on 12/22; ask how this Scripture should shape your words.
topics.prayer: Father, lead me in repentance and faith; teach me compassion in my conversations.

topics.bibleText: But without faith [it is] impossible to please [him]: for he that cometh to God must believe that he is, and [that] he is a rewarder of them that diligently seek him.
topics.reflection: Trust in God is shown when obedience costs us comfort. Ask how this Scripture should shape your words on 12/22; examine your motives in the light of Scripture.
topics.prayer: Father, help me trust and obey Your Word; teach me compassion in my conversations.

topics.bibleText: But ye shall receive power, after that the Holy Ghost is come upon you: and ye shall be witnesses unto me both in Jerusalem, and in all Judæa, and in Samaria, and unto the uttermost part of the earth.
topics.reflection: The Spirit strengthens believers for Christlike living and witness. Let this teaching guide your response to difficulty on 12/22; remember someone who needs your kindness.
topics.prayer: Father, fill me with courage through Your Spirit; teach me compassion in my conversations.

topics.bibleText: And he said unto them, Go ye into all the world, and preach the gospel to every creature.
topics.reflection: The gospel is good news to be shared with compassion. Share encouragement rooted in this passage on 12/22; end the day by reviewing your obedience.
topics.prayer: Father, make me a faithful and gentle witness; teach me compassion in my conversations.

topics.bibleText: By this shall all [men] know that ye are my disciples, if ye have love one to another.
topics.reflection: Christian unity requires patience and practical love. Bring a neglected responsibility before God on 12/22; share encouragement rooted in this passage.
topics.prayer: Father, teach me to love fellow believers; teach me compassion in my conversations.

topics.bibleText: But be ye doers of the word, and not hearers only, deceiving your own selves.
topics.reflection: The Word becomes fruitful when we put it into practice. Let gratitude guide your next action on 12/22; make time for quiet reflection on this verse.
topics.prayer: Father, make me a doer of Your Word; teach me compassion in my conversations.

topics.bibleText: If any of you lack wisdom, let him ask of God, that giveth to all [men] liberally, and upbraideth not; and it shall be given him.
topics.reflection: God gives wisdom to those who ask in faith. End the day by reviewing your obedience on 12/22; consider how this truth shapes your private decisions.
topics.prayer: Father, give me wisdom for today's choices; teach me compassion in my conversations.

topics.bibleText: Therefore be ye also ready: for in such an hour as ye think not the Son of man cometh.
topics.reflection: Watchfulness means living faithfully while awaiting Christ. Look for an opportunity to practise this truth on 12/22; choose humility when your plans are interrupted.
topics.prayer: Father, keep me watchful and faithful; teach me compassion in my conversations.
